key_concepts: Shadows form when an opaque object blocks the path of light
A shadow is an area where light does not reach
Opaque materials make dark shadows, translucent materials make faint shadows, and transpar
Umbra is the part of a shadow where all light is blocked
Penumbra is the outer part of a shadow where only part of the light is blocked
A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon is between the Sun and Earth and casts a shadow on Ea
Solar eclipses require the Sun, Moon, and Earth to be perfectly aligned
Eclipses do not happen every month because the Moon's orbit is not in the same plane as Ea
Total, partial, and annular solar eclipses differ by how much of the Sun the Moon covers
The Moon phase during a solar eclipse is new moon
Viewing a solar eclipse without proper eye protection can damage the eyes
